accent.definition: The way the sounds of a language are pronounced by a speaker, independent of which words they use.
accent.example: He has a strong Glasgow accent but standard vocabulary.

diet.definition: The set of foods an animal eats. The diet can change with the season.
diet.example: A bear's diet is berries, nuts and sometimes fish.

idiolect.definition: The individual version of a language: one speaker's own habits of words and grammar.
idiolect.example: Every email you write becomes part of your idiolect.
